title: the top-level legacy tree is not in the release build or its SBOM inputs
note: basis 'shown' means shown by the card's guard test over the build inputs on int/r1plus1 3390bf74; no image was built.

findings.claim: the release build already excludes the top-level legacy tree: every shipped image is built from a context inside trialbox/, the SBOM inputs are those images and trialbox's own lock, and the bundle's host tree is packed from trialbox/; nothing held this in place before the card's test
the test reads build inputs, not built images: an image's actual file list is not checked
the guard reads the Makefile's assignments, not make's run: an environment override of SC_IMAGES or SC_OWN_IMAGES (both ?=) at release time is not covered
